scope: Read-only audit of the selected GTK2 theme's effective scrollbar stepper mapping, dimensions and installed palette assets.

effective_scrollbar_rules.mapping: GtkRange STEPPER NORMAL/PRELIGHT/ACTIVE/SELECTED/INSENSITIVE references scrollbar-stepper-{up,down,left,right}-{normal,focused,pressed,toggled,disabled}.png in the generated KDE-role palette include.

assets.installed_theme_dimensions: All 20 corresponding scrollbar-stepper assets in the selected theme are 15x15 pixels.
assets.pixel_source_relation: The 16 normal/focused/pressed/toggled cache images equal their repository assets byte-for-byte. Four disabled cache images differ in color data while retaining 15x15 geometry, consistent with adaptive palette output. All selected-theme base scrollbar-stepper files match repository files byte-for-byte.
assets.legacy_sibling_assets: Unprefixed stepper-*.png files are 16x16 in the base theme. The generated palette include maps the GtkRange scrollbar steppers to the distinct scrollbar-stepper-* assets; the unprefixed set is not evidence that the mapped scrollbar arrows are 16x16.

interpretation.conclusion: The selected GTK2 configuration and its adaptive palette include both specify a 15px stepper allocation, with an 11px slider width and 2px trough border. The effective scrollbar arrow assets are 15x15; the selected installed normal cells match the retained SR10.4 cells in R394. R344 supersedes R334’s misregistered cell counts and reports three left and one right outer-relief corner differences; the glyph itself remains exact. This audit does not reproduce the reported smaller appearance.
limits: This is a configuration and asset audit, not a live capture of an already-open GTK2 application.
The historical horizontal held-state comparison in the VM and human visual review remain open.
R334 records one outer relief corner difference on the normal right horizontal stepper; its glyph silhouette is exact.
